Definition: from G5228 and the neuter plural of G1565; above those parts, i.e. still farther:--beyond.
BiblicalUsage: hyperékeina is the word for beyond those parts, still further. In 2 Corinthians 10:16, the text says "To preach the gospel in the [regions] beyond you."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hyperékeina plainly — it means beyond those parts, still further, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
